moments.text: Infrared view looking down at water: three dark elongated shapes in a diagonal row, each trailing a long bright white streak to the upper left.
A small cluster of dark specks enters at the left edge below the left-hand shape and drifts down-right, leaving at the bottom edge.

notes: File is 9.9 s but the official description says 20 s. The official 0:01-0:04 transit matches only the faint speck cluster at lower left (2.0-4.9 s here); the 0:05 entry from the top left is not visible. The frame is dominated by three dark shapes with bright trails that the description does not mention.
